notes: Sizes: SKILL.md is 412 lines, references/package-templates.md 299 and references/ci-and-readme.md 209. check-artifacts.py reports clean and ruff format --check passes. Every nix block passes nixfmt --check, and each one is byte-identical to a fixture file that was actually built. Environment: CppNix 2.35.2 through run.sh, nixpkgs 8d5d2709, store warm. The rust toolchain came from cache.nixos.org, and flake-compat, itoa and actionlint were fetched fresh.

Fixtures live under fixtures/nix-authoring/adopt/. rust-cli/ is the single-crate template. workspace/ is the ocx shape: a git-submodule path dep, two bins, a real itoa git dependency whose outputHashes value came from the fakeHash→got: procedure, and versionCheckProgramArg=version. python-lib/ plus python-consumer/ is the PKG-21 export probed through python312 and python313. legacy/ was modernized into legacy-modernized/. For each of the three templates the full nix.yml run-block set passed under bash -eo pipefail through run-workflow.py, including the Lix and floor legs, and actionlint 1.7.12 exits 0 on the workflow.

Defects planted and watched red: an x86_64-darwin entry (--all-systems exit 1). An untracked package.nix ('not tracked by Git'). A wrong version (versionCheckPhase 'Did not find version'). A missing self.submodules (lib.fileset.unions Element 4 ... does not exist). A missing versionCheckProgramArg ('unexpected argument --version'). A bare pkgs.nixfmt formatter (pname check prints nixfmt). A top-level-only Python overlay (attribute 'toypkg' missing). Lix without flake-self-attrs (exit 1). The rust floor step with channel 99.0.0 (exit 1). Legacy warning count went 3 → 0.

NEW CONTRADICTION for phase 8 or the owner: the overlay text in NIX-PKG-21 (final: prev: … pyFinal.callPackage) fails NIX-GATE-05 because deadnix -L reports 'Unused lambda argument: final'. Renaming it _final breaks NIX-FLK-02, because CppNix rejects an overlay whose first argument is not named final. The template instead passes { inherit (final) lib; } to callPackage. That was built and gated green and needs no lint suppression. The packaging depth-file drafter should adopt this form.

DEFECT in the recorded NIX-PKG-21 verification: 'nix eval … .#via-312.drvPath .#via-313.drvPath' exits with 'unexpected argument' because nix eval takes a single installable. It has to be written as two commands.

Gate-block hazards for whoever wires the E41 security step into a workflow. First, under bash -e a command negated with ! never fails the step, so the workflow uses 'grep … && fail=1' and 'if grep …; then exit 1; fi'. Second, the SEC-02, SEC-03 and SEC-08 patterns match the workflow's own line, so they are written with brackets (accept-flake-[c]onfig, access-[t]okens, trusted-[u]sers). Third, the text '${{ secrets.' inside a run: block gets expanded by GitHub, so the filter is written '{ secrets.'. Each of the five lines was watched red alone and green on the clean tree, which contains the workflow itself.

Measured: a plain clone that did not initialize its submodule still built green with inputs.self.submodules = true, because Nix fetched the submodule from .gitmodules. The CI checkout therefore needs no submodules option.

Commands I reshaped and re-watched myself: the FLK-12 pre-grep is now 'pkgs\.system[^A-Za-z0-9_-]' and 'pkgs\.system$' as separate -e patterns (no \b and no alternation). LANG-07's grep became three -e patterns using [[:space:]]. GATE-12's pin grep became POSIX -e pairs. GATE-13's Q19 grep lost its \b magic-nix-cache clause, since the SHA-pin grep already catches @vN refs. The floor expression now uses builtins.getAttr so shellcheck SC2016 stays quiet, and it still yields nix_2_31. Tools resolve through 'nix shell --inputs-from .' so they come from the locked nixpkgs. The formatter check is 'nix eval --raw .#formatter.x86_64-linux.pname'. The E21 check greps for crane and rust-overlay.

The URL install_url nix-2.35.2 returns HTTP 200. No hosted runner executed the workflow, so GATE-14 and GATE-15 remain untested and are stated as such.

Left out of scope on purpose: a lock-refresh workflow template (the skill points to INP-11 and SEC-07 in one line), and FLK-17's show.json census (the formatter pname check plus the checks output in the template cover it). SKILL.md is 498 lines including frontmatter. check-artifacts.py reports clean. Both nix fences pass nixfmt --check (scratch copies in fixtures/nix-authoring/release/snippets/). There are no python fences, and prose has no em dashes or semicolons.

Watched the release run end to end on 2026-09-27 on a planted toy flake at fixtures/nix-authoring/release/toy/. It has a v1.2.2 then v1.2.3 history, a nixpkgs lock at 8d5d2709 with a warm store, and runs on CppNix 2.35.2. Steps run in order: era read, FLK-16, INP-04 jq, REL-01 pair, REL-03 grep, the output diff against v1.2.2, REL-11 scoped eval, gate steps 1 to 7 (all passed), the computed floor (nix_2_31), the floor leg (2.31.5) and the Lix leg (2.95.2), all exit 0. Then a local annotated tag, REL-02, REL-08, and nix run of git+file://...?ref=refs/tags/v1.2.3 printing 'reltool 1.2.3', exit 0.

Reworded or new commands, each watched red and green. REL-01 and REL-02 are now grep -x -F pipelines with no $(...): the literal twin and the suffix twin exit 1. REL-08: the lock-in-tag twin exits 1. The local-tag nix run: both bad twins exit 1. The output-removal diff (nix flake show --all-systems --json, jq paths, comm -23): silent with a lib.warn shim, 3 lines when the output is deleted. The build-every-package xargs loop: exit 0, and exit 123 with one broken package. The computed floor via --inputs-from: prints nix_2_31, while the remembered nix_2_30 throws. The Lix leg with inputs.self.submodules: exit 1 without --extra-experimental-features flake-self-attrs, exit 0 with it. REL-07 metadata with jq --arg: numtide/flake-utils v1.0.0 gives true, exit 0, and v99.99.99 exits 4. REL-13 eval rewritten to use jq -e, with its pre-screen split into one -e per alternative: the interpolated tag passes, and the literal tag, the literal rev and bare-semver each print false and hit the pre-screen. The REL-17 grep is red on lib.fakeHash.
REL-16 github: form watched on github:Mic92/nixpkgs-review/4.0.0: it printed 'nixpkgs-review 4.0.0', exit 0. The store was likely warm from the earlier w3 R10 run, so this was not a clean-store run.

Copied from consolidations without re-running: the D-branch GEN-15 smoke build, the GEN-16 xargs grep and the GEN-17 jq/cmp check. Also the REL-06, SEC-02 and REL-09 greps, which I did re-run green on the toy. The nix-update invocation itself (w3 R1-R5 --src-only form) was not re-run, and the skill says its cargoHash path is only read from the code.

Deviation for the index drafter to reconcile: the skill runs the floor and Lix legs as 'nix shell --inputs-from . nixpkgs#...' so they use the locked nixpkgs and not the global registry. The consolidation's gate block writes 'nix shell nixpkgs#lix' and 'nix shell nixpkgs#nixVersions.nix_2_31' without --inputs-from. The --inputs-from form was watched.

E12, E28, E29 and E37 applied: the Lix flake-self-attrs flag, the PKG-19 entry point ('-- version' for ocx), REL-16 bound to shape A only with D proved by GEN-15 plus executed README nix run examples, and REL-11's shim-free packages-set wording. 36 of the 46 catalog rows are marked re-verified-2026-09-27. Fixtures were re-planted under fixtures/nix-authoring/diagnose/ (git init plus add, store warm) and run on CppNix 2.35.2, CppNix 2.31.5 and Lix 2.95.2 with run-matrix.sh. The re-verified rows are 1, 2, 5-8, 10, 12-26, 29, 30 (classic half), 31, 33-42 and 45. Row 7 ran on nixf-diagnose 0.1.4, row 45 on deadnix 1.3.2, row 35's Invalid half on flake-checker 0.2.15, and row 29 on nixfmt 1.5.0 under 2.35.2 only.
10 rows are carried-from-research: 3, 4, 9, 11, 27, 28, 32, 43, 44 and 46. Also carried are the nixfmt-rfc-style half of row 30 and the FlakeLock half of row 35.

New C20 evidence contradicts the consolidation. For a path:../sibling input outside the git tree, Lix 2.95.2 prints `relative path '../sibling' points outside of its parent's store path`. evaluation-failures section 2 said Lix matches CppNix's `access to absolute path … forbidden`. The catalog and the C20 table record the measured split.

Further C20 splits, all new. (a) Lix 2.95.2 prints no hint for imports computed from config, even under --show-trace, while CppNix 2.31.5 and 2.35.2 print it; this changes the LANG-10 class (b) procedure on Lix. (b) The pkgs.system rename is prefixed `evaluation warning:` on CppNix and `warning:` on Lix. (c) Lix's hash-mismatch layout adds `likely URL:`. (d) Lix's rec-set-merges error is parse-time and fires for every attribute of the file, and its text now suggests `--extra-deprecated-features rec-set-merges`, which the skill lists as a weakening. (e) nixf-diagnose quotes the name in backticks. (f) The CppNix hint text uses backticks around config and imports.

Row 41's fixture showed that an eval-time builtins.fetchurl with no sha256 fails first with `in pure evaluation mode, 'fetchurl' requires a 'sha256' argument` on all three implementations. This is noted in the row.

The C7 42-module twin (`cannot coerce an integer to a string: 42`) was re-verified on all three implementations and added to the misattributed-diagnostics table. That table also holds the manifest 404 (NIX-GEN-05), the digest 404 (NIX-GEN-09), versionCheckPhase (NIX-PKG-19), nix-installer's silence (NIX-INP-13), E1's -source is not valid (NIX-FLK-07), pkgs.system (NIX-FLK-12), helix's fetchTree cost (NIX-INP-10), infinite recursion (NIX-LANG-10) and the Lix stack overflow (NIX-INP-08).

Citation fixes. Catalog rows that cited 'NIX-LANG (localization)' now cite live IDs, because LANG-09 is retired and absorbed as procedure steps 1-5: row 5 cites NIX-GATE-07, row 6 NIX-LANG-07, rows 11 and 14 NIX-LANG-08, and rows 1-4 NIX-LANG-10. Row 8's allowUnfree citation moved from NIX-PKG-15 to NIX-FLK-11, per nix-packaging.md line 220 (FLK-11 owns the configured instance). Row 36 cites NIX-FLK-16.

E11 is applied to the GATE-09 triage table: a cold-store `-source' is not valid` is an author defect (NIX-FLK-07, NIX-PKG-15), and 'checker limit' is confined to IFD, which gets its own row pointing at NIX-GATE-08. The not-a-defect list excludes the self-source case. I kept the x86_64-darwin throw out of 'not a defect' because NIX-FLK-09 makes it an author fix, which the map's bullet contradicts.

The -v watchdog commands in the SKILL were watched. The line-gap awk command is new: it showed a 20 s gap on the blackhole-fetch twin (connect-timeout 20) and 0 s on the compliant twin. `set -o pipefail` was added because, without it, a pipe masks timeout's exit 124; with it I watched 124 on the hang twin and 0 on the compliant twin. The FLK-07 grep hit 1 on the bad twin and 0 on the good twin, and git ls-files listed the untracked file. The flake-checker two-command classification gave count 1 on the crash and 0 on the clean twin.
No rules were dropped. The skill defines no rule rows. MUST duplicates appear only in a | # | Finding | Rule | table of 16 rows, with the rule ID last. Frame Q6 and Q8 are stated as pinned defaults.
Not measured: Determinate Nix (stated in the skill), and the eval-cache staleness repro, which is still carried and stated as an environment gap.

ADR written, Status: Proposed, 369 lines, in the ocx house shape (Metadata, Context, Decision Drivers, Industry Context, Considered Options, Decision Outcome, Consequences, Technical Details, Implementation Plan, Validation, Open Questions, Links, Changelog). It has a Contents line, no em dashes, no semicolons in prose, and no /home paths. Evidence is cited by paths relative to the corpus's .agents/research/ directory.

D1 to D14 settle every item listed in Authoring notes 12(c). Generator: `ocx index nix`, which reuses Index::select (crates/ocx_index/src/lib.rs:810), select_best, is_compatible and compatibility_score (crates/ocx_oci/src/platform.rs:518/416/485), ocx_oci::Client (client.rs:284, fetch_manifest :716, pulls with ACCEPTED_MANIFEST_MEDIA_TYPES) and the template grammar (ocx_package/src/metadata/template.rs:202). Also settled: the ocx-sh/ocx-nix repo (Q4 pinned), fetchurl with Bearer QQ== and the verbatim digest, the attribute shape with `final: _prev:`, the libc template, the cmake-gui ignore-list policy, meta mapping, env/entrypoint/deps with self.env inlined by the generator, the systems list, the Q5 history rule, a daily reviewed-PR update loop under an App token, GEN-18 yanked/deprecated handling, no cache and no nixConfig, and README examples that CI executes. The index asks A1 to A5 are recorded, and M-E-10 is left open.

Decisions the ADR adds beyond the corpus (reversible, flagged for owner review): the subcommand name `ocx index nix`, an `overrides.json` in ocx-nix as the reviewed source of per-package autoPatchelfIgnoreMissingDeps (the generator cannot learn it without building), an explicit registry repository per package in data.json, and a daily cadence.

M-E-20: ocx ships sign/verify (adr_oci_referrers_signing_v1.md). I read the ocx-mirror sources on 2026-09-27 and found no upstream-signature check before push. This is a reading, not a measurement, and the ADR says so.

Migration list: the prototype status and the seven breaks from item 12(b), plus two findings made by reading, not run and not among the seven. (1) lib/mk-package.nix maps licenses with getLicenseFromSpdxIdOr id null and filters the nulls, so it silently drops unmapped ids such as corretto's `GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0` (NIX-GEN-14 deviation). (2) lib/fetch-layer usage hardcodes `repo = ocx-contrib/${ns}/${pkg}`.

Watched while drafting (CppNix 2.35.2 via run.sh). The gate step `nix flake check --all-systems --no-build --option allow-import-from-derivation false .` exited 0 on a prototype copy (green/) and 1 on a twin with packages pointed at the version tree (red/: `is not a derivation`). The ADR's nix snippet passes nixfmt 1.5.0 --check and deadnix --fail, and nixfmt was watched red (exit 1) on a misformatted twin. All other Validation commands are copied verbatim from rows the consolidation records as watched red and green. The three unwatched Nix-level twins (GEN-20 self.env and the mixed-token throw, GEN-21 flake-level meta, GEN-22 throw) are listed as acceptance prerequisites, not as commands.

Checker: after I fixed three broken relative links to ocx ADRs (now plain `.claude/artifacts/...` code paths), the only finding left on the ADR is structural: 'support file is not routed to from the rule index'. The checker treats files in nix-generated-flakes/ as support files of the consolidation. This does not apply because the ADR is not a lore artifact, so I report checker_clean true as the brief instructs. The other findings the checker printed are in pre-existing corpus files I must not edit.
No rules dropped: this is an ADR, not a rule artifact.
